title: Finding
description: One piece of evidence about a part, wire or net from one source. A finding is a suspect, never proof, unless its source is repairos.meter (I1). Findings feed fusion, and go to Grain /call as findings[] once target T4 lands (until then as text in `question`). Grain results are wrapped as findings with a grain.* source and keep Grain's own verdict and row in `grain`.

state.description: Scan states (ok partly shifted missing, Phase 2), Grain /look states (ok broken missing shifted damaged worn dirty loose unsure), wire states (unseated wrong_pin colour_mismatch open short), meter state out_of_range, discovery states (unexpected_*), and honesty states (not_seen_in_photo not_inspected insufficient_evidence). Grain mapping: diagnose verdict ok->ok, partly->partly, shifted->shifted, damaged->damaged, not_seen->missing, not_visible->not_inspected; /look state 1:1; electrical row verdict ok->ok, off->out_of_range, open->open, pin_not_on_net/unknown_net/no_expected->insufficient_evidence (a probe or naming problem, not a fault).

source.description: Which stage produced it. Grain sources are wrapped Grain results, kept separate so they are never merged with our measurements.

confidence.description: Source's own confidence. Not calibrated; fusion recalibrates.

is_proof.description: True only when source is repairos.meter. Enforced in code.

evidence.description: Short human sentences, e.g. 'housing gap ~2 mm (still s7)'. These go to Jev and Grain.

crop_box_px.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the source still's pixels.

crop_file.description: Full-resolution crop saved for the UI and for a Grain /look second opinion (Grain stores photos downsized).

render_file.description: CAD render of the same view (the 'normal' reference).

reading_id.description: MeterReading id when source is repairos.meter.

measurements.description: Numbers stay here. They are converted to words before reaching Jev (S5).

offset_mm.description: Mean signed distance along the surface normal, mm.

shift_mm.description: Translation in the design frame (mm, Z up), as Grain's shift_mm.

views.description: Number of stills or keyframes that saw the subject.

vlm_answer.description: Structured answer from the crop-pair question, when source is repairos.vision.

grain.description: For a grain.* source: what Grain said, unmapped, so the mapping above can be audited.

verdict.description: Grain's word: a diagnose verdict, a /look state, an electrical row verdict, or a /call fix action. null when Grain gave none (e.g. an electrical row without a verdict today, G22).

name.description: Grain part name (diagnose parts[].name), a finding's where, or a fix's part string.

ref.description: Grain's BOM ref (diagnose parts[].ref); null for made parts.

confidence.description: As Grain gave it: a number for /look, a word (low|medium|high) for /call fixes.

raw.description: The Grain object this came from (a part row, observation, reading row or fix).

ref.description: part: the Grain part name, i.e. the model.glb node (diagnose parts[].name, e.g. U1 or a sub-part U1:usb) -- not the BOM ref, which is null for made parts; wire: the harness.csv name; net: the net name.

pins.description: Optional REF.PIN ids in Grain's net naming, e.g. SW1.1.

subject.description: What the finding is about. Maps onto Grain's target subject {kind, id, pins} (T3/T4) with ref -> id.
